description:
How a company's people speak on podcasts, together, and how that moves over time: the share of their lines that are negative, neutral or positive; hedged, neutral or confident; vague, neutral or specific; and about the past, present or future, overall and per week or month (the last year by default), with how many of the people said them. Use it for 'how confident do OpenAI's people sound lately' or 'are Microsoft's executives talking more about the future'. Pass include=['examples'] for each bucket's strongest line per outer label, with who said it (a person_slug for `particle_person_get_statement_characteristics`), the episode and a link that plays the moment.

The people are the ones `particle_company_get` lists with include=['people']: current roles by default, past ones too with include_past_roles. Shares are of their scored lines (lines too short to read carry no characteristics); low_sample marks fewer than 20 behind a share. For one person, use `particle_person_get_statement_characteristics`. Resolve the company first with `particle_company_resolve`.

company_slug.description: Company identifier — slug from particle_company_resolve (e.g. 'microsoft'), domain (e.g. 'microsoft.com'), or canonical ID.

include.description: Optional sections: 'examples' adds each bucket's strongest line for every outer label (negative/positive, hedged/confident, vague/specific, past/future) with its episode and a link that plays it. Lean by default.

include_past_roles.description: Count people in past roles at the company too. By default only the people in a current role count.

interval.description: Bucket width (default month). Weeks start on Monday (UTC).

output_format.description: Output serialization. 'markdown' (default) returns the LLM-facing rendering. 'json' returns the structured payload as JSON text — use only for programmatic chaining where exact field extraction matters; the JSON shape is larger and noisier for an LLM to read.

published_after.description: Start of the window (ISO 8601 date or date-time). Defaults to a year before published_before.

published_before.description: End of the window: a bare date includes that whole UTC day. Defaults to now.

name: particle_company_get_statement_characteristics
title: Particle Company Get Statement Characteristics
